[1/1] Plan: close a DNS-rebinding hole: the server issued a session cookie and a readable csrf cookie from an unauthenticated bootstrap route and never looked at the Host header, so a page on an attacker domain rebound to 127.0.0.1 could reach the API including the terminal. Add server/hosts.ts and a first middleware that answers 421 HOST_REJECTED for any Host that is not localhost, a localhost subdomain, an IP literal or an operator listed name, with the list from ATELIER_ALLOWED_HOSTS

impact_assessment.why: A local tool that can run commands must not be drivable by a web page; cookie, token and csrf checks all pass for an attacker whose own domain resolves to loopback
impact_assessment.benefits: Closes a remote-command-execution path for anyone who browses the web while atelier runs, with no change for normal use
impact_assessment.risks: contract: requests with a DNS-name Host other than localhost are now refused, so a reverse proxy or custom name needs ATELIER_ALLOWED_HOSTS; dependency: none; concurrency: stateless middleware; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reject by default, IP literals and localhost always allowed so LAN use and the vite dev proxy keep working, list entries validated so a typo cannot widen access, 6 unit and 2 http tests first, a real-socket check with forged Host headers, a real-browser control run

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Host guard shipped: server/hosts.ts hostAllowed and parseAllowedHosts, first middleware in createApp answering 421 HOST_REJECTED before any cookie is issued, ATELIER_ALLOWED_HOSTS wired through main and help, README and docs/FEATURES.md. 8 new tests (6 unit, 2 http) written first, existing 24 api tests still pass, tsc clean, 10/10 gates. Real-socket proof against the running server: Host 127.0.0.1 and localhost answer 200 with a session cookie, Host evil.example and 127.0.0.1.evil.example answer 421 with no cookie. Real-browser control run through the real server unchanged at 390/768/1440. Also fixed README tree drift: committing made 43 tracked server and src files visible to the README tree gate, entries and descriptions added. No UI change. checklists: passed

impact_assessment.why: Delegate helper conversations cluttered the sidebar and search, and atelier run --continue could pick one as the most recent conversation
impact_assessment.benefits: A conversation list that only shows what the user started, and a continue command that cannot attach to an internal session
impact_assessment.risks: contract: GET /api/sessions and search no longer return delegate sessions, getSession is unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only query change; state: none, no schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Identified by a run with a parent run id, which ordinary retry and fork runs never have, so normal conversations stay visible, five tests first including that guard, full suite of 489 tests run
